name: Feed Consumption Analysis
query: SELECT dte.entry_date as "Date:Date:100", dte.farm as "Farm:Link/Poultry Farm:120", dte.shed as "Shed:Link/Poultry Shed:120", dte.batch as "Batch:Link/Poultry Batch:120", dtei.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:120", dtei.qty as "Qty:Float:100" FROM `tabDaily Flock Entry` dte JOIN `tabDaily Flock Entry Item` dtei ON dtei.parent = dte.name WHERE dte.docstatus = 1 AND dtei.item_code LIKE '%%Feed%%' ORDER BY dte.entry_date DESC
